name: The Tinker
description: A first-through who opens things. Fifteen, two years in the Yards before anyone let them near a door, and the only one in their intake who can tell a failing anchor from a sulking one.
narrative:
You were taken on because you fixed a pressure door nobody had asked you to
touch, and then explained what had been wrong with it. The Threshold has a word
for people who do that and the word is useful.

Your suit is older than you are and you have improved it in four ways that are
not strictly permitted.

powers.name: Life Support
boosts: Hard vacuum and hard radiation, both (2 PP)
limits: External Power Source -- the pressure-skin, and it can be taken
